title: Residual-risk gate did not improve downside at threshold 0.5
interpretation: The validation-selected neural risk gate matched arbitrage exactly in warning mode. Both failed the downside objective against no-trade on 100 new matched groups. Range-based abstention missed one +0.02 virtual USD outcome without changing tail loss. This configuration does not demonstrate a risk-adjusted decision benefit.
caveats: Synthetic hypothetical fills and costs; no real profitability or empirical execution claim.
The two challenges reuse the same 100 identities; 3000 variants are correlated.
Selection used validation only; new classification final tests remain unopened. The neural validation improvement only narrowly exceeded the preset tolerance.
This is a bounded negative finding for a fixed threshold, not proof that all risk forecasting or abstention policies fail.
next_experiment: Preregister threshold and full/half sizing selection using validation-only economic outcomes, then evaluate once on a genuinely new seed block. Do not retune against opened challenges.
synthesis_method: Human-readable synthesis from verified immutable manifests and episode-grouped paired comparison; no model promotion or parameter update.
